versions.localizedDescription:
Hawoo everywan its been half a year since the last release I'm really sorry because ever since beta build I got lazy from release a new version, anyways

This version introduces:

- Optimization for iOS 26
- Bulk installation support for multiple apps
- idevice installation method
- Custom injection path & support for injecting tweaks into App Extensions
- Support for .bundle files as tweaks (copied directly into the app bundle)
- rsd support
- Fix empty display name handling in Info.plist
- Fix URL scheme issues for Ksign
- Fix codesigning errors on specific apps with unusual bundle structures
- Localization updates for German, Russian, Arabic, and Vietnamese
